title: Resolve the remaining watcher limitation for source edits after a carried check's closing capture
outcome: Track the deliberately unresolved broad post-exit edit behavior separated from the legacy terminal-routing repair. A provider-reported edit and an independent filesystem watcher notification can describe the same write. The watcher currently conservatively fences an ended reported check because notification receipt/processing does not prove write time. Any future exemption must positively order the actual write after required capture; unknown or in-flight write-and-restore evidence stays fail-closed. This record grants no watcher redesign, new diagnostics, profiling or live prompts. Fable1313/Architect2 ruling2b28f050 requires returning to Greg with a bounded proposal if the symptom recurs after the narrow fix is live.
acceptance: Record the unresolved watcher-only and duplicate provider/watcher behavior with the original incident provenance, distinguishing measured results from unproven incident causes.

Before any implementation, obtain a scoped design disposition identifying a concrete producer fact that orders the actual write after completed capture; receipt/processing time, mtime, elapsed delay, matching endpoint content and ended() alone are insufficient. If no safe fact exists, explicitly retain conservative behavior.

Any authorized correction has deterministic positive and negative regression coverage preserving in-flight writes, delayed write-and-restore, unknown timing, exact source and claim identity; no diagnostic/live run is implied by this item.
